name: Gulshan Grover
bio:
​From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia.

Gulshan Grover  (born 21 September 1955 in Rampura Jorbagh, New Delhi) is an Indian actor, who has appeared in several Hindi and Punjabi language films.
